name: chronomap
description: ChronoMap Engine — plug-and-play spatio-temporal storytelling maps

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && tsc -p packages/maplibre/tsconfig.json && node packages/maplibre/scripts/copy-css.mjs
scripts.build:demo: npm run build && vite build apps/demo
scripts.vectors: npm run build:engine && node packages/engine/dist/cli.js --vectors test-vectors data/campaigns/*.json data/campaigns/fixtures/*.json
